rationale_md: France enters this Group I fixture as overwhelming favorites, backed by a substantial 250-point Elo rating advantage over Senegal that reflects their status as one of world football's elite nations. The model assigns Les Bleus a 71% win probability, suggesting Senegal faces an uphill battle to extract points despite their standing as Africa's highest-ranked side. While the 10% chance given to a Senegalese victory appears slim, upsets remain possible in tournament football when underdogs can maximize set-piece opportunities and defensive organization against superior opposition.
